description: For those who doesn't have a team
summary:
"To not be forgotten, you must first etch an emotion into their hearts"

I developed a web application telling the story of the Lunar Rover Vehicle of Apollo 15 assuming that he/she has emotions and in a first POV. It addresses the challenge by using the POV of the moon buggy about his thoughts and experiences while on its mission. 

This is important especially to teenagers and young adults who are very attuned with their emotions, to feel the importance of these moon buggies so they wouldn't be forgotten.

Repo: https://github.com/meziahh/Team08.git
details:
I created a web application about Lunar Roving Vehicles or Moon Buggies. Specifically the moon buggy of Apollo 15 in the year 1971.

When you go to the Apollo 15 tab, you will see the full story of that Moon Buggy, as he/she narrates it from the first POV. The story mainly focuses on the experience during their mission.

I used Claude for code suggestions and debugging. I used HTML, CSS, and Javascript for the development. I also used Canva for designing the clipart of moon buggies.

To make this project creative, I mainly narrated the story on how the moon buggy must have felt throughout their mission and what it must have felt today.

I considered if it will affect other's emotions.

The quote from the summary is original by the way.
dataRefs: Used for the story and pictures of the LRV of Apollo 15
